facts.business: Mercantile Ventures Limited primarily engages in property investments for leasing purposes and provides manpower supply services.
key_risks: Complicated site acquisition procedures, approval hold-ups and regulatory environment
Growing construction expenses and shifting raw material prices
Affordability concerns due to inflationary pressures and growing interest rates
Rapidly changing workforce expectations, digital disruption, and global uncertainties for manpower firms
Significant exposure towards ICD granted to EDAC Engineering Ltd and recognition of ECL involves significant judgment regarding recoverability and credit risk assessment
Substantial FVOCI investments and recognised significant OCI losses along with deferred tax assets, involving valuation and recoverability judgments
Corporate guarantee exceeding net worth, requiring judgment regarding probability of invocation and disclosure adequacy
Recognition of Deferred Tax Asset involves significant judgment regarding future taxable profits and recoverability of timing differences
